biggest_catch: None beyond the form requirement: the friend must physically present the printed referral form at account opening — without it, no reward is paid.
catches: The printed referral form is mandatory; friend must present it at account opening — no retroactive referrals.
Friend must complete at least 20 debit card purchases per month for the first 3 full statement cycles.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: 1st University CU's official page (culink.net/refer-a-friend) runs a Refer-a-Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns $50 for each friend who opens a new checking account and meets the qualifications. Rewards are explicitly unlimited — no annual cap.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: referrer prints and fills out the official Refer-A-Friend form with their name; friend presents the form when opening a new checking account; friend makes at least 20 debit card purchases per month for the first 3 full statement cycles.

c4.evidence: Timing: the $50 reward is deposited to both parties' savings accounts within 5 business days of meeting all requirements.

eligibility: 1st University CU members referring friends who open a new checking account; the form must be presented at account opening.
notes: Official page states 'Unlimited Rewards' explicitly in the FAQ.

payout_value_note: Cash deposited to the referrer's savings account, not a gift card.

steps: Print and fill out the 1st University CU Refer-A-Friend form with your name.
Your friend presents the form when opening their new checking account.
Friend makes at least 20 debit card purchases per month for the first 3 full statement cycles.
The CU deposits $50 into both savings accounts within 5 business days of meeting all requirements.
timing: Within 5 business days after the friend meets the debit card usage requirement.
when_cash_arrives: Within 5 business days after the friend meets the debit card usage requirement. The referral must be presented in person (printed form or coupon at a branch) - it cannot be done fully online.
maximize: Hand your friend the physical referral form/coupon and have them present it at account opening - missing it voids the referral.
Pair the branch visit with same-day qualifying activity (first debit transaction, initial deposit) to start the clock immediately.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the in-person handoff requirement makes this slower than pure digital referrals.
